english.note: Use this specifically for the digestive organ rather than the whole belly area.
Use 胃 when you mean the stomach specifically as a digestive organ rather than the general belly area.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 wai6 m4 syu1 fuk6

examples.english: After eating so much spicy food, my belly can't take it.
examples.traditional: 食咁多辣嘢，我個胃頂唔順。
examples.jyutping: sik6 gam3 do1 laat6 je5 ngo5 go3 wai6 ding2 m4 seon6
